name: SendGrid
description: Allows site to send emails using Sendgrid email service.
project_description:
Sendgrid email module that uses the official sendgrid PHP library .

 This module requires mailsystem .

 Installation instructions 
 
 Install as any other module (See Installing modules instructions ) 
 Add your Sendgrid credentials in the settings configuration form: /admin/config/services/sendgrid/settings 
 Optionally set a debug mode, the ip pool name and other options.
